svg.aria-label: 四线纽扣电池夹具：上下两个绝缘夹臂各有两块触点，电流触点 I 和感应触点 V；上面负极盖一侧接红 CE 和白 RE，下面正极壳一侧接绿 WE 和蓝 WS；触点和导线的接触电阻不计入结果；用前检查触点干净平整，用异丙醇擦净。

text.style: fill:rgb(19, 28, 38);fill-opacity:1;stroke:none;stroke-opacity:1;stroke-width:1px;stroke-dasharray:none;stroke-linecap:butt;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:1;font-family:"IBM Plex Sans", "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700

svg.text: 电流触点 I 走电流，感应触点 V 只测电压：

text.style: fill:rgb(86, 97, 110);fill-opacity:1;stroke:none;stroke-opacity:1;stroke-width:1px;stroke-dasharray:none;stroke-linecap:butt;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:1;font-family:"IBM Plex Sans", "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:400

svg.text: 触点和导线的接触电阻不计入结果，低阻电池最需要
